jev_vs_baseline.question: Is Jev better calibrated than a temp-0 LLM baseline on the same items? Compare primary_delta_ece across clients; accuracy delta is reported so the reader can see whether the comparison is at roughly equal accuracy.

verdict: The data support a ΔECE distinguishable from zero, but not in the pre-specified hard-worse direction (CI excludes zero from below) (point ΔECE=-0.11508636363636365, BCa [-0.3900564505824348, -0.01805506490175077], percentile [-0.21459806818181823, 0.17334090909090885], n_hard=22, n_easy=22). The M∈{5,10,15,20} sweep does not flip the primary sign. On the adapter baseline under the same items and equal-n rule, ΔECE=0.14 (BCa [0.09590909090909094, 0.17909090909090922]). The four-tier ECE-vs-accuracy slope remains descriptive only.
